## Purpose

Describe the problem, the assurance claim and the smallest compatible change.

## Compatibility and trust impact

- [ ] No authenticated bytes or trust semantics change.
- [ ] Or: the applicable new version, specification and conformance vectors are included.
- [ ] Recovery, operator and privacy implications are documented.

## Evidence

- [ ] `npm run test:all`
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage`
- [ ] `npm run scan:repository`
- [ ] Relevant live qualification is recorded or explicitly not applicable.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off under `DCO.txt`.

Do not attach credentials, private keys, customer content, production `.g9p` objects or confidential vulnerability details.
